[# [Literature Review] A scalable adaptive deep Koopman predictive controller for real-time optimization of mixed traffic flow](/file? The paper titled "A scalable adaptive deep Koopman predictive controller for real-time optimization of mixed traffic flow" presents a cutting-edge approach to managing traffic flow involving both connected automated vehicles (CAVs) and human-driven vehicles (HDVs). The research focuses on leveraging the Koopman operator theory to predict and control the dynamics of mixed traffic systems, which is essential in urban environments where diverse vehicle types coexist. Building on the predictions from AdapKoopNet, AdapKoopPC implements a model predictive control framework aimed at optimizing the control inputs for CAVs in real time.
